note: This extension uses TOOL PARAMETERS for configuration, not config files. Configure when LLM calls the tool.

question.description: The question text displayed to the user

description.description: Optional help text shown below label

example_usage.code: question({ question: 'Choose an option', options: [{ label: 'Option A', description: 'First choice' }, { label: 'Option B' }] })

return_value.question: string - the original question
return_value.answer: string | null - user's selection or custom text
return_value.wasCustom: boolean - true if user typed a custom answer

keyboard_shortcuts.enter: Select current option or submit custom answer
